name: Bushwhack

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Requirements You are undetected by a creature.

---
You appear from seemingly nowhere to grab an unsuspecting victim. Stride up to 10 feet and attempt to grapple a creature you are undetected by. If you succeed, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier (@actor.system.abilities.str.mod bludgeoning) to the target (double damage if you critically succeed).
